a: Miiles is a tool for creators and creatives: it brings portfolios, templates, design and video assets, boards and artificial intelligence together in one place.
It is built for content creators, UGC creators, designers, editors, freelancers and anyone who wants to create, organize and share their work.

faq_items.q: What can I create with Miiles?
a: You can design and publish your portfolio, organize clients and campaigns on boards, and use templates and assets to edit video, animate and shape your ideas.
You can also connect your AI to create and edit your own pages without relying on a code repository.
For content creators, designers, editors, independent creatives and teams who want their resources and work in one shared space.
You do not need to know how to code: start with a template and adapt it to your style.
No. Miiles is not a marketplace for buying or selling services between businesses.
It is a tool for creating: it gives you assets, templates, boards and AI to develop and showcase your own work.

faq_items.q: Do I need design or prompting skills?
a: No. You can start with a template or describe what you want in plain language.
Miiles helps with the structure, and you decide the content, style and final result.
You can start for free. The Pro plan costs USD 24 per month or USD 230 per year (save 20%) and includes unlimited projects and collaborations, advanced analytics and priority support.
For teams and companies there is a custom Business plan.
